about: Susan T. Bart attended law school and graduated from The University of Michigan Law School in 1985. Susan Bart began practicing law in 1985.
Susan Bart is an attorney at ArentFox Schiff LLP, helping people with Estate Planning & Probate issues. ArentFox Schiff LLP has an office in Chicago, Illinois, serving the local community.

Susan Bart was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
